children: S&P 500 September futures were quoted at 7,717.75 at 9:01 a.m., down 4.25 points, or 0.06%, from the previous close, according to ETNet.

The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield was 5.246%, compared with 5.25% previously. The 10-year yield was 4.778%, the five-year yield was 4.550%, the three-year yield was 4.451% and the two-year yield was 4.379%.
In precious metals, local London gold was quoted at 4,615.13/4,615.47 and local London silver at 66.40/66.45. Ninety-nine gold was quoted at 41,325.

title: S&P 500 September Futures Edge Lower; U.S. Treasury Yields Mostly Steady
